notes: Six synthetic 0xca-byte grid cells with owner +0x00, mode +0x1a, object byte +0x4f and reset state +0x20 varied; cell index 0..5 or 0xff (with garbage high bits); stack rate double and immediate dword. All eleven callees are loggers; 0x2ced4 and 0x2d488 log both rate words and pop 8 bytes, 0x7489c/0x2dee4/0x2dce0 return per-case values.
